test_cpu_offload: test CPU offloading by splitting model between GPU and CPU with configurable max memory
test_disk_offload_with_safetensors: test disk offloading with safetensors serialization by loading model with constrained GPU memory
test_group_offloading: test block-level and leaf-level group offloading with and without non-blocking streams
test_layerwise_casting_memory: test memory footprint reduction when using fp8 storage dtype with fp32 or bf16 compute
test_layerwise_casting_training: test training with layerwise dtype casting using fp16, fp8_e4m3fn, and fp8_e5m2 storage dtypes
